entities.summary: Diamantino Guapo Antunes, I.M.C. is a Portuguese Catholic prelate who is the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Tete in Mozambique, since 22 March 2019. Before that, from 20 July 1994, until he was appointed bishop, he was a priest of the religious Order of the Consolata Missionaries. He was appointed bishop by Pope Francis. He was consecrated bishop on 12 May 2019 at Tete, Mozambique.
